summary: German noun typo: Rücksieht → Rücksicht
rationale: The fixed expression is “Rücksicht darauf nehmen”. The corpus translation repeats the spelling error “rücksieht”; it does not justify the erroneous noun in the entry.

summary: German adjective ending: eines grünes Baumes → eines grünen Baumes
rationale: After “eines” the genitive singular adjective takes -en: “eines grünen Baumes”. The supplied corpus translation has the same grammatical slip; the correction is unambiguous German inflection.

summary: German participle: herüberkommen → herübergekommen
rationale: In “so wäre ich nicht ...” the verb must be the past participle “herübergekommen”. “Herüberkommen” is the infinitive.

summary: Supply the missing English subject: (Perhaps) he is

summary: German imperative typo: Gibt → Gib

summary: Belief uses clauses, while evaluation uses an object suffix and a nominal or adjectival predicate. Reflexive ruḥo alone does not distinguish feeling (2), self-regard (4), and ordinary self-classification (1).
Preterit thinkers have L-suffix coding in ḥšuli etc.; these occurrences do not establish the qaṭəl experiencer pattern. Infectum-wa describes continued past beliefs, often subsequently disproved.
Detransitive label 1 covers socially assigned classification with no expressed agent, including kinship, engagement and debt. Numerical reckoning is separated as Detransitive 2.
Several sources duplicate existing references: Hors 2/150 = MM 150; Hors 3/26 = RT 26; Talay 1/81 = LB 81; Talay 1/363 = LB 363. They are not independent supporting examples.
Compact rows lack source verses and cannot be independently checked beyond the supplied synopsis. They supply no new quotations.
